messages.content: You are a concise programming assistant. Explain assumptions and keep answers under 100 words.
Design a Python cache with a 60-second TTL.
Store each value with a monotonic expiry timestamp. On get, remove and return no value if the timestamp has passed.
How should I test expiry without waiting in real time?
